def transform(g):

def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(c for r in g for c in r); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if any(c!=bg for c in r)]
    groups=[]; cur=[rows[0]]
    for i in rows[1:]:
        if i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        else: groups.append(cur); cur=[i]
    groups.append(cur)
    bl=[(gr[0],gr[-1],max(j for i in gr for j,c in enumerate(g[i]) if c!=bg)) for gr in groups]
    (a,b,w1),(c,d,w2)=bl
    narrow,wide=((a,b,w1),(c,d,w2)) if w1<w2 else ((c,d,w2),(a,b,w1))
    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    for k,rn in enumerate(range(narrow[0],narrow[1]+1)):
        rw=wide[0]+k
        cols=range(narrow[2]+1, wide[2]+1)
        ext=[g[rw][col] for col in cols]
        if ext and all(v!=bg for v in ext):
            for col in cols: g[rn][col]=1
    return g
